thread:
elaine: quick flag — ran the autoscale soak at 6pm and hit a weird p99 tail cluster during scale-up. p95 looked fine but p99 jumped ~4-6x for ~90s.

sam: ugh, any correlation with kernel selection or batch sizes?

elaine: initial trace shows kernel flip from `opt-attn-v2` -> `fallback-gemm` during the scale event. KV cache hit-rate tanked at the same time. snippet from profiler: 
```
2026-03-15T18:02:14Z scale-event start RPS=1500
kernel_selector: chosen=opt-attn-v2 (seq=32)
18:02:20Z instances scaled +3
18:02:21Z kernel_selector: fallback -> fallback-gemm (seq=32)
KVCache: global_hit=0.24 -> 0.12
batching: microbatch_size target=8 -> actual=2
latency p95=420ms p99=1250ms
```

mina: sounds like two issues colliding: kernel mismatch on new nodes + cold KV caches. fallback-gemm is ~3x slower for short seqs.

andrew: did we prewarm kernels on new workers? I thought the scaleup job runs `kernel-prober` automatically.

elaine: prober did run but it probes with synthetic seq=128 load; we use seq distribution centered ~32 in prod so the selector chooses different kernels after real traffic arrives. prober doesn't cover microbatching behavior.

sam: aha. prober mismatch + cold KV => small real microbatches (clients reflow) -> selector flips to fallback. That explains tail.

deploy-bot: NOTE: rollout 2026-03-15T17:45 -> scaled group `infer-prod-3` +3 instances.

mina: options: (1) make prober include short-seq microburst probes, (2) pre-seed KV cache on new nodes with prefix warming, (3) force kernel pin for 30s after scale, (4) increase microbatch target during warmup.

andrew: my +1 is (1) + (2). Probing with seq=32 and microbatch=4 should get selector to choose the same kernel. prefix warm can be cheap — replay small sample of production prefixes.

sam: also consider adding a short `kernel-stability` scoring window so transient flips don't change runtime choice until confidence > 0.6. reduces flip-churn.

elaine: agreed. proposal: implement quick probe change today (seq=[16,32,64], microbatch=[2,4,8]) + KV prewarm hook to run top-1k prefixes, then rerun soak. I'll open an RFC and a small patch.

mina: can you include a short perf regression check in the CI to catch p99 delta > 20% on a scaled-up scenario? We had a regression last month that only showed up under autoscale.

elaine: yes. adding CI job: `autoscale-smoke` that does 30s ramp to target and checks p95/p99 and kernel stability.

ops-bot: ACTION created: ops/infra#1145 "microburst prober + kv prewarm" assigned to elaine, due 2026-03-18. :calendar: 

sam: sweet. follow-ups: (a) export a heatmap of kernel choice vs seq length across scale events, (b) add alert when p99 > 2x baseline and KV hit < 0.3 during scale.

elaine: noted. I'll attach profiler traces in the RFC. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
